newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador cellphone firm to issue $100 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador cellphone firm to issue $100 mln in bonds.

text.p: Telephone firm Conecel SA will issue $100 million in bonds, the general manager of Ecuador's Central Bank, Fidel Jaramillo, said on Friday.
"There is a private company, Conecel, which will issue a $100 million bond in dollars for a 10-year term under the auspices of UBS," Union Bank of Switzerland, he told reporters.
Jaramillo said a recent bond issue by the Ecuadorean government could pave the way for a "successful issue" by Conecel, one of the two Ecuadorean firms providing cellular telephony.
